title: Earth Defense Force 6.2 Invaders From Another World Game Announced for PS5
content:
D3Publisher announced on Tuesday Earth Defense Force 6.2 INVADERS FROM ANOTHER WORLD, an updated version of its Earth Defense Force 6 game which will launch for PlayStation 5 in 2027. The updated game will include newly added enhancements for the console. The new game will be playable at the upcoming Tokyo Game Show 2026 on September 17-21.

The Earth Defense Force 6 game launched in Japan in August 2022 for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. (The game had been delayed and was previously slated for the end of 2021.) The game launched in North America in July 2024 after a delay . Clouded Leopard Entertainment also released the game in English in Asia in 2024. The game's story takes place three years after the Earth Defense Force 5 game .

D3Publisher released the Earth Defense Force 5 game digitally on PS4 in the West in December 2018. The game launched in Japan in December 2017, and launched on PC via Steam in July 2019. PQube released a physical version of the Earth Defense Force 5 game for PlayStation 4 in North America and Europe in September 2020.

D3Publisher launched Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 , a sequel to the Earth Defense Force: World Brothers spinoff game, for PS5, PS4, and Switch in May 2024. The game launched in the West in September that same year.
author: ANN

title: Chainsaw Man Reze Arc Movie New Visual Revealed, Heads to Prime Video in Japan on September 19
content:
Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc will begin streaming exclusively for Prime Video members in Japan on September 19, 2026, marking exactly one year since its theatrical debut. A new visual was also released alongside the announcement. Chainsaw Man International Assassins Arc anime is currently in production . The film opened theatrically in Japan on September 19, 2025, continuing the story from the Chainsaw Man TV anime’s first season. It follows Denji as he meets Reze, a girl working at a neighborhood café, and quickly grows close to her before the encounter completely changes his daily life. The film won the Anime Movie of the Year award at our 6th yearly awards .

The film had recorded more than ¥29.7 billion in worldwide box office revenue as of June 19, 2026.

The main staff:

• Director: Tatsuya Yoshihara

• Screenplay: Hiroshi Seko

• Original Story: “Chainsaw Man” by Tatsuki Fujimoto

• Production: MAPPA

Japanese voice cast:

• Kikunosuke Toya as Denji / Chainsaw Man

• Reina Ueda as Reze

• Tomori Kusunoki as Makima

• Fairouz Ai as Power

• Shogo Sakata as Aki Hayakawa

• Shiori Izawa as Pochita

• Natsuki Hanae as Beam / Shark Fiend

Crunchyroll began streaming the film outside Japan on April 30, 2026. It describes the movie:

Based on the hugely popular anime series, Chainsaw Man continues in an all-new epic, action-fueled adventure. Amid a brutal war between devils and hunters, another battle starts in Denji’s heart when he meets a mysterious girl named Reze. Facing secret enemies and fighting for his humanity, Denji revs up for his deadliest battle yet.

Tatsuki Fujimoto first started the Chainsaw Man manga in 2018, and Part 1 ended in 2020 with a total of 97 chapters and 11 volumes. Part 2 began in July 2022, running for 135 chapters until its ending on March 25 . Viz Media licensed the manga in English.

The first anime season premiered last fall, and it ran for a total of 12 episodes. MAPPA CEO Manabu Otsuka said that the Chainsaw Man anime was a complete financial success . Kenshi Yonezu performed the opening theme song “KICK BACK,” while each episode had a different ending theme song performed by a different artist.

Crunchyroll is also streaming the TV anime, and they describe the story: Denji is a teenage boy living with a Chainsaw Devil named Pochita. Due to the debt his father left behind, he has been living a rock-bottom life while repaying his debt by harvesting devil corpses with Pochita. One day, Denji is betrayed and killed. As his consciousness fades, he makes a contract with Pochita and gets revived as “Chainsaw Man”–a man with a devil’s heart.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fall in Love, You False Angels' Manga Goes on Hiatus
content:
The October issue of Kodansha 's Dessert magazine announced on Monday that Coco Uzuki 's Fall in Love, You False Angels ( Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ) manga will enter a hiatus, due to the creator's health, and also so she can adjust her workload. The series will return in the January 2027-cover-dated issue in November.

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

All sugar, no spice, and everything nice… that's the impression the beautiful first-year high schooler and “heartthrob angel” class president Otogi Katsura gives to those around her. In reality, Otogi is brash, assertive, and has no problem calling out a jerk when she sees one—the complete opposite of her soft spoken vice presidential counterpart, the equally beautiful and seemingly perfect Toki Ninomae. One day, when a group of boys try to hit on her at the train station, Otogi doesn't hold back and gives them a piece of her mind—and, to her surprise, Toki enjoys seeing this side of her. Not only that, it turns out the seemingly polite, put-together vice president has a hidden side of his own… and Otogi now finds him more attractive than ever! Now “partners-in-crime,” Otogi and Toki agree to keep their hidden sides a secret from the rest of their classmates—but could this shared, dark secret also bring them closer together…?!

Uzuki debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Dessert magazine in April 2023. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on June 12.

The manga won the Shōjo category in the Kodansha Manga Awards in 2025, earned a nomination for the Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2025, and ranked in the top 20 on the list of manga for female readers for Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook in multiple years.

Animation studio MAPPA announced in June that it is producing a television anime adaptation for next year.
author: ANN

title: Whisper of the Heart UK IMAX Screenings From September 15
content:
Some online UK listings have appeared for IMAX screenings of Studio Ghibli 's 1995 film Whisper of the Heart , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō , in mid-September. The venues include the BFI IMAX cinema, where tickets are available for subtitled screenings on September 16 and 17; Bradford's Science and Media Museum, where tickets are available for both dubbed and subtitled screenings between September 16 and 20; and also screenings at some UK Odeon cinemas on September 16.

GKIDS previously acquired the UK and Ireland distribution rights to 23 Studio Ghibli films, and it announced that it would be screening Whisper of the Heart in UK cinemas. It is currently reissuing the Ghibli film Kiki's Delivery Service on UK IMAX screens, with a wider release to follow from Friday (August 28).

GKIDS released the (English-dubbed) trailer for Whisper of the Heart below, when it reissued the film in America earlier this year.

GKIDS describes the Whisper of the Heart film's story:

"A chance encounter with a mysterious cat sends Shizuku, a girl with her head in the clouds, on a quest for her true talent. Together with Seiji, a boy determined to follow his dreams, and enchanted by The Baron, an antique cat figurine who guides her to listen to the whispers of her heart, Shizuku embarks on a life-changing adventure that takes her beyond the boundaries of her imagination. Based on a screenplay and storyboards from Hayao Miyazaki , Whisper of the Heart is a precious gem in the Studio Ghibli catalog, directed by veteran animator Yoshifumi Kondō ."
author: ANN

title: Anime Music Concerts in London in September, Birmingham in November
content:
The two-hour concert is described as follows:

"Feel the thunder, wonder and emotion of your favourite anime moments as a full symphony orchestra performs scores from legendary shows and movies.

"Hear music from Naruto , One Piece , Demon Slayer , Attack on Titan and many more, alongside timeless soundtracks from Studio Ghibli and Makoto Shinkai .

"From spine-tingling battle themes to breathtakingly beautiful melodies, this is anime music on an epic scale."

The London event specifies that Under-12s must be accompanied by an adult on our site. The Birmingham event specifies that Under-16s must be accompanied by an adult.

The Japan Nakama website offers discount codes for both events.

title: Live-Action Sakamoto Days Film Opens in Hong Kong on September 17
content:
Hong Kong film distributor Neofilms announced last Friday that it will open the live-action film of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga in Hong Kong on September 17.

The film opened in Japan on April 29, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 346,000 tickets and earned 478 million yen (about US$3.05 million) in its first three days. In its first eight days in the Japanese box office, which spanned the entirety of the Golden Week holidays, the film sold 1.14 million tickets and earned 1.5 billion yen (about US$9.58 million).

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are publishing the manga in English digitally. Viz is also publishing the manga in print. MANGA Plus describes the story:

Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villains and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! the chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

Snow Man member Ren Meguro stars as Tarō Sakamoto, and Fumiya Takahashi plays Shin Asakura. Aya Ueto plays Tarō Sakamoto's wife Aoi Sakamoto, while Miyu Yoshimoto plays Tarō Sakamoto's daughter Hana Sakamoto. Other cast members include Mayū Yokota as Lu Shaotang, Junki Tozuka as Heisuke Mashimo, Akihisa Shiono as Kashima, and Keisuke Watanabe as Natsuki Seiba. Takumi Kitamura , Yūsei Yagi , and Meru Nukumi play Order assassins Nagumo, Shishiba, and Osaragi, respectively.

Yūichi Fukuda (live-action Gintama , Under Ninja ) directed and wrote the script for the film. Keiya Tabuchi ( Evangelion: 3.0+1.0: Thrice Upon A Time , live-action Attack on Titan , Kamen Rider Amazons ) directed the action. CREDEUS produced the film with Avex Pictures .
author: ANN

title: Creepy Nuts Make Guest Appearances in The Weeknd's Asian Tour Leg
content:
Japanese hip-hop duo Creepy Nuts announced on June 3 that they will be special guests for some concerts on the Asian leg of singer-songwriter The Weeknd's long-running After Hours Til Dawn tour. In Southeast Asia, Creepy Nuts will guest on the concerts in Singapore; Bangkok, Thailand; and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

The Singapore concert will take place at the Singapore National Stadium on October 2 and 3. The Bangkok concert will take place at the Rajamangala Stadium on October 11 to 13. The Kuala Lumpur concert will take place at the TM Stadium National on November 4 to 5.

Creepy Nuts is comprised of DJ and composer DJ Matsunaga and rapper and lyricist R-Shitei . The duo saw their debut in 2013 and later signed with Sony Music Entertainment Japan in April 2017. Since signing with Sony Music Entertainment , Creepy Nuts performed theme songs for the Call of the Night , DAN DA DAN , and Mashle: Magic and Muscles anime. They have won awards for their songs. They have also appeared as cameos in Call of the Night .

title: Rock is Your Lady's Modesty UK Blu-ray Scheduled For November 2
content:
Rock is a Lady's Modesty premiered in Japan on April 3 2025. The anime is described as follows:

For Lilisa, every day at Oushin Academy is another day of pretending to be someone she's not, all to please her new rich stepfamily by becoming one of the school's elegant “Noble Maidens.” And it sucks, because with her new fake persona, she can't even play the guitar her real dad left her. But when she discovers one of the school's other “perfect girls” smashing out her frustrations on a set of drums, Lilisa realizes that maybe she's not alone. Maybe her dreams are closer than she'd thought. Of course, that's assuming that they can find enough other closeted lady rockers and form a band in ROCK IS A LADY'S MODESTY !

Shinya Watada ( Aikatsu Stars! , The IDOLM@STER Million Live! ) directed the anime at BN Pictures , and Ōri Yasukawa ( Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Separation , Migi & Dali episode director) was the assistant director. Shōgo Yasukawa ( Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma , A Certain Scientific Railgun T ) was in charge of series scripts, Risa Miyadani ( Aikatsu! Planet , Wonderful Precure! The Movie! ) designed the characters, and Yasufumi Soejima ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) was the visual director.
author: ANN

title: Burnout Syndromes Band Holds Concert in Manila on September 5
content:
The Burnout Syndromes band announced on July 20 that it will hold a concert in Quezon City, Metro Manila on September 5. The concert will take place at The Crossroad Center near Timog.

Burnout Syndromes performed the opening themes for three seasons of the Haikyu!! anime, and the ending theme song "Hana Ichi Monme" for the fourth season of Gintama . It also performed the theme song for the first season of Dr. Stone , the Those Snow White Notes anime, and the Dr. Stone: Ryusui anime special. The band most recently performed the opening theme song for The Misfit of Demon King Academy II anime, and the ending theme song for the third part of the Dr. Stone: Science Future anime.
